name: Neuhütten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of yellow with a narrow green cross, charged at the crossing with the municipal arms of Neuhütten (a green bird on white above green).
history: Municipal flag of Neuhütten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuhütten arms — bird on white above green
